answer: Gate emission on a per-identity semantic challenge whose prompt is unpredictable and whose answer must be unique. Seed words shift each epoch like a turning tide, so a copied reply is a whisper everyone has already heard and dies on answer-hash collision. A real grove of distinct agents each writes original text; a sybil farm cloning one template collapses into duplicates that machine checks and peer graders both reject. Novelty, not volume, earns reward.
